minutes.title: Project Kick-off Meeting
minutes.summary: The meeting kicked off the project design for a new remote control. Decisions were made on pricing, production costs, and functionality. Next steps include determining production costs vs. selling prices.
decisions: The product will sell for 25 euro
We aim to make 15 million euro from selling this remote control
International sales are planned, with a target price of no more than 1250 euros

actions.task: Determine production costs vs. selling prices

open_questions: What information is given about the product?
Is 25 euros a premium price for the remote control?
